description: The ETFs performance endpoint provides comprehensive performance data for exchange-traded funds globally. It returns detailed metrics such as trailing returns and annual returns, enabling users to evaluate the historical performance of various ETFs. This endpoint is ideal for users looking to compare ETF performance over different time periods and assess their investment potential.
